title: Authentication is attribution, not authority
summary: AuthenticationAssertion and AuthenticationVerifier bind a sealed principal/key to exact evidence. Both AccessControlAuthority and PermissionAuthority additionally require the request principal to equal the attributed principal before policy evaluation.
invariants: A valid signature/MAC proves attribution and integrity but grants no Access Control or Permission.
request.principalId must equal attributedPrincipal.principalId when attribution is supplied.
An authorized signer cannot truthfully sign a request for another subject and inherit that subject's rights.

provenance.claim: Authentication validity alone does not establish request subject; request principal must equal attributed principal.
AccessControlAuthority checks principal equality and verifies exact Access Control attribution before policy evaluation when attribution is supplied.
